nodes.label: Auto-disable cheats on logout
nodes.rationale: Every cheat is switched off automatically on logout so nothing leaks into the next world.

nodes.label: Design rule: State is the only source of truth
nodes.rationale: State holds all toggles. Patches only read it; Features/* reconcile game fields against it every frame and restore originals when a toggle goes off. Keeps cheats reversible and avoids divergent toggle state across patches and features.
nodes.norm_label: design rule: state is the only source of truth

nodes.label: Per-frame reconciliation of game fields against State
nodes.rationale: Features re-apply cheat values to game fields every frame and restore originals when a toggle goes off, so game code that resets fields does not silently undo a cheat, and disabling is always clean.
nodes.norm_label: per-frame reconciliation of game fields against state

nodes.label: Build (dotnet build, VALHEIM_DIR, Managed assemblies, BepInEx NuGet feed)
nodes.rationale: BepInEx and Harmony come from the BepInEx NuGet feed (nuget.config) so the project compiles even before BepInEx is installed; game assemblies are referenced straight from valheim_Data/Managed.
nodes.norm_label: build (dotnet build, valheim_dir, managed assemblies, bepinex nuget feed)

nodes.label: Krafs.Publicizer
nodes.rationale: Exposes the private m_ fields of game classes that the Harmony patches and features need to read and write.
